# Florence 1347 – Life sciences

K = knowledge level · use = none/wrong/partial/correct · make = producibility with local means · accept = acceptance.

- **Microorganisms (living things too small to see)** [`microorganisms`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/microorganisms.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept medium. Needs the single-lens microscope first; spectacle makers grind only weak convex lenses. What is seen will be read as worms bred by putrefaction, not its cause. Local: spectacle makers; glassmakers.
- **Life comes only from life (spontaneous generation refuted)** [`spontaneous_generation_refuted`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/spontaneous_generation_refuted.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Aristotle and everyone else: maggots come from rotting meat, eels from mud, bees from ox carcasses (Virgil). Covered-jar experiment is cheap and convincing.
- **Fermentation is the work of living yeast** [`fermentation_yeast`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/fermentation_yeast.md) — K0, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Bakers keep sourdough and vintners work with fermenting must. Fermentation is understood as a kind of boiling or digestion, not the work of a living thing. Local: vintners (Arte dei Vinattieri); bakers (Arte dei Fornai).
- **Cell theory** [`cell_theory`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/cell_theory.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Bodies are made of humours and uniform parts (flesh, bone). Needs a good microscope and thin sections; no practical use people can see.
- **Viruses (disease agents smaller than bacteria)** [`viruses`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/viruses.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept low
- **Systematic classification and naming of living things** [`taxonomy`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/taxonomy.md) — K2, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Plants are known from Latin Dioscorides, Pliny, the Circa instans and alphabetical synonym lists. Apothecaries substitute freely. Theophrastus is unknown; no botanical garden. Local: apothecaries; monastery herb gardens. Elsewhere: Salerno, physic garden and Pandectae (1317) of Matthaeus Silvaticus.
- **Egg, sperm and fertilisation** [`reproduction_fertilisation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/reproduction_fertilisation.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Aristotle: male seed gives form to menstrual blood; Galen: both sexes give seed. Mammal eggs and sperm are invisible without a microscope. Touches theology (ensoulment).
- **Heredity by discrete factors (Mendel)** [`heredity_genetics`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/heredity_genetics.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept medium. Breeders know like begets like. Counting ratios over generations takes records and several years; one season in a garden proves little.
- **Evolution by natural selection** [`evolution_natural_selection`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/evolution_natural_selection.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. A breeder can show variation and selection. Species are fixed since Creation; saying otherwise before the Dominican and Franciscan inquisitors is a risk.
- **DNA is the hereditary material (double helix)** [`dna_structure`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/dna_structure.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept low
- **Breathing is slow combustion (respiration and body heat)** [`respiration_metabolism`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/respiration_metabolism.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Galen: breathing cools the heart's innate heat and feeds vital spirit. A mouse and a candle under a glass both die: easy to show, hard to explain.
- **Plants are built from air, water and light (photosynthesis and mineral nutrition)** [`photosynthesis_plant_nutrition`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/photosynthesis_plant_nutrition.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept medium. Plants are thought to eat the fat of the soil through their roots. A weighed pot experiment takes years; the role of air cannot be shown.
- **Legumes fix nitrogen from the air (root nodule bacteria)** [`nitrogen_fixation_biology`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nitrogen_fixation_biology.md) — K2, use partial, make easy, accept medium. That lupins and beans 'fatten' the soil is read in Palladius and Crescenzi and done by good farmers. Why is unknown; the nodules are taken for a disease. Local: Pier de' Crescenzi's Ruralia commoda (manuscript, c. 1305).
- **The brain and nerves (seat of thought, electrical signalling)** [`nervous_system_brain`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nervous_system_brain.md) — K2, use partial, make hard, accept medium. Galen's view holds: animal spirits flow through hollow nerves; faculties sit in the brain's ventricles. Aristotelians favour the heart. Electrical signalling is unprovable here.
